about.metaDescription: Meet Example Company: our story, our values and how we work with small businesses. Demo content.
about.title: About us
about.lead: A small team that believes small businesses deserve the same care that large companies get.
about.storyP1: We started as three people helping friends organize their businesses. The team grew, but our way of working stayed the same: listen first, explain clearly, and work with the owner, not instead of them.
about.storyP2: This page is demo content for a fictional site. Replace all of the text with the words of your real project.
about.value1Text: We write in plain language and tell you the price and the time up front.
about.value2Text: Your time and budget matter. We never suggest what you do not need.
about.value3Text: We do not stop at delivery. A month later we ask: did the solution work?
about.teamText: Six consultants, trainers and support technicians, most of whom have worked with us for years.
